visual_action: A montage shows Donald Trump in various presidential and formal settings. He walks with Melania Trump on an airport tarmac near a helicopter, shakes hands with Robert F. Kennedy Jr. indoors, salutes military personnel, walks with JD Vance and Pete Hegseth, and waves to a large crowd in an arena. The video also shows a helicopter (Marine One) taking off from the White House lawn, and concludes with black and white shots of the White House.
